title: Claude Code
subtitle: Create, attach to and govern Claude Code sessions — no SSH. Every launch is policed; every session is observable.

transport.streamJsonHint: Bidirectional NDJSON bridged and governed in full by Olivares.
transport.remoteControlHint: Lifecycle only — I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud, so it cannot be shown here.

badge.governedHint: Tool-calls are policed in line by the governed PEP.
badge.denyClosedHint: No PEP provisioned — every tool-call is denied (the session can think, not act).
badge.recordingHint: Bridged I/O anchored as signed ledger evidence.
badge.criticalHint: Privileged launch — required human approval and mandatory recording.

create.title: New Claude Code session
create.description: Olivares launches and governs the process — the visual equivalent of the CLI launch, with policy in line.
create.name: Name
create.isolationNativeOnly: Only native is wired this release; container/sandbox are refused.
create.envAllowHint: Allowlist of host env var NAMES to pass through (values are never sent).
create.criticalWarning: This is a privileged launch (it removes the per-tool prompt). It requires a two-person approval and is recorded — it may stay pending until approved.
create.classifiedWarning: A read-write mount of a classified workspace is a privileged launch (approval + recording).
create.templateHint: The engine merges the template's terms over the fields above before the launch gates, and writes them into the session's own process — so the restriction holds for a caller that never opens this console.
create.templateUnenforceable: This template declares terms this launch cannot enforce, so the launch is refused rather than started without them:
create.templateOverrides_one: The template overrides {{count}} of your choices:
create.templateOverrides_other: The template overrides {{count}} of your choices:

detail.minimalData: Minimal-data: no secrets, tokens, env values, prompts or transcripts are stored — only references and flags.

live.inputPlaceholder: Send an NDJSON line to stdin…
live.lag: {{count}} frame(s) dropped (buffer overflow) — output below resumes after the gap.
live.remoteControl: This is a remote-control session: its I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud and is not bridged here. Olivares manages the lifecycle only.
live.notLive: This session is not live (it is {{state}}). Resume it to attach to its I/O.
live.inputNotAllowed: Input is only accepted while the session is running.

gov.title: Governance posture
gov.subtitle: What governs this session right now.
gov.pepProvisioned: Governed — every tool-call is policed in line
gov.pepDenyClosed: Deny-closed — no PEP provisioned, so every tool-call is denied
gov.pepRemote: Not bridged — remote-control I/O is governed by Anthropic
gov.budgetHint: Per-inference budget is enforced at the gateway.
gov.recordingOn: On — bridged I/O anchored as signed ledger evidence
gov.recordingOff: Lifecycle only — full I/O recording not enabled for this session
gov.noPermission: You don’t have permission to view this signal.

events.title: Lifecycle ledger
events.subtitle: Each transition is anchored by PayloadHash to the signed audit ledger.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Host directories a session works in — mounted, jailed and DLP-classified.

empty.title: No workspaces registered
empty.description: Register a host directory to give sessions a governed working tree and a file browser.

create.title: Register a workspace
create.description: Register a host directory root. The file API jails every access to this root — symlink escapes and ".." are refused, never clamped.
create.name: Name
create.rootPathHint: Absolute, canonical host path. Resolved at registration.
create.allowSubpathsHint: Optional allowlist of relative subpaths exposed (empty = the whole root).

workspaces.deleteBody: This removes the registration only — it never touches files on the host. Sessions pointing at it will fail to launch.

browser.title: Files
browser.readOnlyWorkspace: This workspace is read-only — edits are disabled.
browser.binary: Binary file — preview not shown. Download to inspect.
browser.truncated: Read truncated at the size cap — download for the full file.
browser.pickFile: Select a file to view or edit.
browser.deleteBody: This deletes the entry from the host workspace. It cannot be undone.
browser.deleteRecursive: Delete folder and all its contents (recursive)

empty.title: No Claude Code sessions
empty.description: Create a governed session to run Claude Code from the console — no SSH. Olivares launches the process and polices every tool-call.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: You don’t have permission to operate Claude Code sessions.
